meta.notes: Two triggers, one job. Weekly schedule + POST /webhook/tech-enrich (the Tech Intel tab's Enrich button). Resolves CVEs (NVD, by Shodan-known ID > CPE > product keyword), MITRE ATT&CK techniques, and public exploit availability (local PoC-in-GitHub mirror), then WRITES THEM BACK onto each Technology/Service node under nodeProperties.* -- cve_count, cves, mitre_techniques, poc_count, exploit_available, top_pocs, composite_risk. That write is what makes WF12's vulnerable_tech[] and the frontend's Vulnerable Technology panel populate; before it existed those fields had five readers and no writer. Also refreshes the MITRE STIX bundle and the RAG collections (cve_index, poc_index, mitre_index, tech_guides, asset_inventory). Responds onReceived: a full pass is minutes long at NVD's rate limit, so the webhook acks immediately and the operator re-runs Tech Inventory to see results. REQUIRES scripts/sync_poc_mirror.py to have been run on the host for exploit data.
